description: Deletes a specified Sentry organization metric alert rule. An HTTP 202 response yields an empty result, indicating that the deletion request was accepted for processing.

inputSchema.description:
Request parameters for deleting a metric alert rule from a Sentry organization.

Metric alert rules monitor aggregated metrics over time (e.g., error rate, latency percentiles)
and trigger notifications when thresholds are exceeded. This action permanently removes the
specified alert rule. Note: Metric alerts require a Business or Enterprise Sentry plan.

alert_rule_id.description: The numeric ID of the metric alert rule to delete. This ID can be obtained from the alert rule's URL in the Sentry UI (https://sentry.io/organizations/{org}/alerts/rules/details/{alert_rule_id}/) or by listing alert rules via the API. Note: Metric alert rules require a Business or Enterprise Sentry plan.
alert_rule_id.title: Alert Rule Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization. The organization slug is a URL-friendly name (e.g., 'my-organization'), while the ID is a numeric string. You can find this in your Sentry organization settings URL: https://sentry.io/settings/{organization_slug}/
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: DeleteOrganizationAlertRuleRequest

name: delete_organization_alert_rule

DeleteOrganizationAlertRuleResponse.description:
Empty response body. The DELETE organization alert rule endpoint returns HTTP 202 Accepted on successful deletion.

This means the alert rule was successfully deleted and there is no response body content.
HTTP 202 indicates that the request has been accepted for processing.
DeleteOrganizationAlertRuleResponse.title: DeleteOrganizationAlertRuleResponse
